measurement_protocol: Use the fixed formal Scene 04 start placement.
Measure the shortest collision-free path feasible for the robot body independently of the executed trajectory.
End at the boundary of the declared 0.5 m valid plant goal region.
Apply the same independently measured reference to the current Scene 04 formal metric track.
